pipInstall.mirrorHint: Force PyPI repository URL > Config item `PyPI Repository Address`

exportLogs.hint: Packs the log files under data/logs and the recent in-memory logs. Without "Enable File Logging", only the in-memory logs are included. Logs may contain chat messages and user IDs, so check them before sharing publicly.

debugHint.text: Debug logs can be enabled in "Configuration File → System → Console Log Level"
